remarks:
Welcome to this exceptional 3,000-square-foot center entrance Colonial nestled in the highly sought-after
Braunview Estates. Situated on one of the largest lots in the neighborhood, this meticulously maintained home offers modern updates and beautiful outdoor living. Step inside to discover gleaming hardwood floors, spacious living areas, and a warm gas fireplace that serves as the focal point of the home. The updated kitchen features quality finishes, abundant cabinetry, and seamless flow for everyday living and entertaining. Updated baths, modern mechanics, and a brand-new tear-off roof (2025) provide peace of mind for years to come. Offering 3 generously sized bedrooms and 2.5 baths, this home combines comfort and functionality with ample living space throughout. The full unfinished basement presents endless possibilities for future expansion, recreation, or storage. Outside, your private backyard oasis awaits. Enjoy summers by the stunning gunite pool, unwind in the hot tub, and take advantage of the expansive yard! This home is ideal for entertaining, recreation, or simply enjoying the serene setting. A 2.5-car garage completes this impressive property. An incredible opportunity to own a beautifully updated home in one of the area’s most desirable neighborhoods. Showings for prequalified buyers begin immediately with 24 hour notice, offers will be reviewed as they are received. Difference in Sq ft is agent measured
